product_summary: Erode, Tamil Nadu (H-19, Periyar Nagar, Erode 638009). Self-described manufacturer, supplier and exporter of native and modified starches: native maize/corn starch, tapioca (cassava) starch and flour, potato starch, rice starch, plus modified starches E1401 (acid-treated), E1414 (acetylated distarch phosphate), E1420 (acetylated), clean-label and pregelatinised (cold-water-soluble) starches. Also sweeteners: liquid glucose, high-maltose corn syrup, maltodextrins of various DE, dextrose monohydrate/anhydrous. Also instant food mixes under own retail brand 'Foodix' (instant soup mix, instant food mix, gravy thickener GRAVY-Y-O, chicken coating agent ChikMat, lactose substitute for paneer). Large non-food line: textile yarn sizing (oneshot sizing, thin-boiled starch, binder/softener/lubricants, printing/finishing), paper & packaging starch, foundry starch, gypsum board binder, charcoal briquette binder, agarbatti & mosquito coil binder, oil-drilling starch, starch for detergents, starch for fireworks, binder for plaster of Paris. Sources: https://www.angelstarch.com/ and https://www.angelstarch.com/about-us/ (product categories, sweetener list, brand Foodix); IndiaMART catalogue https://angelstarchandfood.com/ (product cards with E-codes and prices).
role_hint: manufacturer (own plant in Erode; states Sree Mangalmoorthi Starch Industries started 1990, Angel Starch & Food Pvt Ltd incorporated 2010; IndiaMART profile lists 'Nature of Business: Manufacturer'). Trader signs: none material - sells own-produced starches, though it also resells/brands instant mixes under 'Foodix'. No evidence of pure trading.
comment: Declared 110812 (maize starch), 110814 (cassava starch) and 350510 (modified starches) are all directly corroborated by the company's own product pages and IndiaMART catalogue - core match is correct. Status 'partial' only because the declaration omits several real product lines that the company actively markets: (1) potato starch 110813 and rice starch 110819; (2) glucose/glucose syrup 170230/170240, maltodextrin and dextrose 170290 - explicitly listed as manufactured sweeteners on the site; (3) instant food mixes / soup mixes / gravy thickeners 190190 or 210690 under brand 'Foodix'; (4) a substantial non-food industrial starch line (foundry, gypsum board, briquette binder, agarbatti/coil binder, oil-drilling, detergents, fireworks, plaster of Paris binder) which would fall under 3505 or 3824 depending on formulation. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is only partly right: roughly half the catalogue is industrial/technical starch for textiles, paper, foundry and binders, so the company is a starch processor serving both food and non-food industries, not an FMCG company. Per project rule 3, the HS gap is not a rejection ground - keep the company and correct/extend the code list to the actual range above. All product identifications here come from the company's own website and its IndiaMART catalogue, i.e. marketing declarations; no customs line was available in this task, so every code above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research was performed (out of scope for this role).
